title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the bodies of 22 private members out of protocol.ts into eight themed modules (#25467 cut 33)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDs1YApZetPpXnckKDrvuBk)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 `protocol.ts` 里 22 个私有方法的方法体原样搬进 8 个按主题划分的新文件（存储行绑定、显式降级、overlay 索引、视图容器判断、包提交记录、包作用域、`/meta` 铸造拒绝、SDUI 清单），类上的方法、签名和文档注释都保留，只剩一行调用。
- 为什么改：#25467 拆分超大文件 `protocol.ts` 的第 33 刀。单个成员一刀只能减 6 到 10 行，这次按派发令一次搬完所有通过筛查的私有成员；筛完后私有成员这条线已经搬尽。
- 风险与回滚：低。22 个方法体逐 token 相同（2,061 个 token，差异 0），发布的 `.d.ts` 与 `main` 原始字节完全相同，包测试与 `main` 逐条比对 0 丢失 0 变化，只多了 4 条新登记行带来的用例；回滚就是还原这一个 PR。
- 先看：`protocol.ts` 里带 `[#25467 cut 33]` 标记的 22 个桩方法，以及 `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts` 里新增的 4 行 `PRODUCERS` 登记。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts src/protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Cut 33 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–32 landed; cut 32 is #27406. The claim is `6489357157`. The dispatch asked for a batch: start from cut 31's alternative (`6465513012`, `storedRowKnownDatasources`), screen every remaining private member with a live body on fresh `main`, and move every one that passes in one PR under 3,000 lines, grouped by theme.

22 `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into 8 new modules under `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` (#23050 shape B):

| Module | Members (base line, body lines, AST tokens) | Host |
|---|---|---|
| `protocol-stored-row-bindings.ts` (113 lines) | `storedRowKnownDatasources` (`:6555`, 6, 102), `overlayLockLayerAt` (`:10478`, 13, 138), `resolveOverlayPackageBinding` (`:19272`, 11, 65) | `StoredRowBindingsHost` |
| `protocol-loud-degradations.ts` (69) | `throwMetadataServiceUnavailable` (`:9407`, 7, 29), `warnClosureReadUnavailable` (`:23514`, 9, 36) | `LoudDegradationsHost`; the first reads no member |
| `protocol-overlay-index.ts` (95) | `ensureOverlayIndex` (`:8017`, 37, 160), `ensureOverlayMembersBackfilled` (`:8072`, 3, 28) | `OverlayIndexHost`, with getter and setter for the two one-shot flags |
| `protocol-registry-view-predicates.ts` (122) | `expandStoredViewContainers` (`:10277`, 7, 76), `runtimeViewContainerObject` (`:18209`, 4, 53), `copiesOwnShippedViewContainer` (`:18241`, 2, 32), `isAnotherPackagesObject` (`:18295`, 6, 59), `registryTakesStoredRows` (`:18647`, 1, 13), `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames` (`:20018`, 6, 82) | `RegistryViewPredicatesHost`; `runtimeViewContainerObject` reads no member |
| `protocol-package-commit-record.ts` (137) | `persistPackageCommitRow` (`:26369`, 2, 24), `recordPackageCommit` (`:26397`, 71, 342) | `PackageCommitRecordHost` |
| `protocol-package-scope.ts` (150) | `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal` (`:16236`, 28, 175), `isWritablePackage` (`:16577`, 1, 12), `shouldDropStorage` (`:19325`, 6, 53), `resolveAppPackageIdKey` (`:10582`, 38, 323) | `PackageScopeHost`; `shouldDropStorage` reads no member |
| `protocol-unmintable-meta-type.ts` (62) | `refuseUnmintableMetaType` (`:19495`, 17, 82) | `UnmintableMetaTypeHost` |
| `protocol-sdui-manifest.ts` (77) | `resolveSduiManifest` (`:6750`, 12, 66), `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad` (`:28937`, 13, 111) | `SduiManifestHost`; the second reads no member |

Base lines are `protocol.ts` at `main` `f7188b562b`, which is byte-identical to the claim's base `c5d4634174` for this file. 300 body lines and 2,061 AST tokens in total.

- **The class keeps every member**: name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one call into its module, marked `// [#25467 cut 33] The body moved to ...`.
- **Shape B, as cuts 20–32.** A body that reads `this` builds one `const host: ThisParameterType<typeof fn> = {...}` and returns `fn.call(host, ...)`. Methods are passed as closures over `this`, fields as getters, and the two written flags (`overlayIndexEnsured`, `overlayMembersBackfilled`) as getter plus setter. The host type is the module's one named context; there is no second copy. The 4 bodies with no `this` call the plain function directly, as cut 26 did. The generic `resolveAppPackageIdKey` is called as `(resolveAppPackageIdKey<R>).call(host, ...)`.
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** No call site changes and no member changes visibility.
- `protocol.ts` goes from 29,508 to 29,346 lines. The PR is +982 / −312 over 10 files, 1,294 changed lines. The card stays open for later cuts.

### Screened and rejected

Every private, non-static class member with a live body on fresh `main` was screened. A member had to pass four checks: no private-static read, no `this.constructor` read, no by-path reader of its body, and an unchanged read-seam census (`--list` included). Each candidate was also run through the package suite and the hand gates on a trial tree. These 40 stay:

| Reason | Members |
|---|---|
| Reads a private static (7) | `isSealedManagedItem` (`registryAllowsOverlay`), `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` (`mergesOverlayAtRead`), `recordOptimisticConflictAudit` (`optimisticConflictAuditEntry`), `applyObjectRegistryMutation` (`overlayPackageMismatchError`; also the register-item and write-through pins, and the ADR-0029 seam), `reconcileViewExpansions` (`registeredViewExpansions`; also its pins), `promoteDraftForPublish` (4 statics; also the view-expansion pin), `readRevertableCommit` (`organizationScopedWriteRefusal`) |
| `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites` pin keys `lookupArtifactItem(` sites by member in `protocol.ts` (11) | `packagedArtifactBase`, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`, `readFlattenedMetaItems` (also view-expansion), `readMetaItem`, `isArtifactBacked`, `isNestedArtifactField`, `shippedViewContainerOf`, `runtimeViewContainerPackage`, `isShippedByAnotherPackage`, `expandRuntimeViewContainer`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` |
| Other by-path pins on `protocol.ts` (11) | `emitMetadataMutation` (recovery-doors counts `this.emitMetadataMutation(` and its private declaration), `applyRemoteMetadataMutation` (recovery-doors body scan, view-expansion), `getOverlayRepo` (view-expansion: `new SysMetadataRepository(` must sit in it), `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` (lookup, register-item, view-expansion, hydrate-canonical-type), `hydrateExpandedViewItems` (view-expansion), `applyRegistryWriteThrough` (view-expansion, write-through, hydrate), `restoreArtifactRegistryView` (register-item, view-expansion), `runPublishSideEffects` (view-expansion, recovery-doors), `ensureObjectStorage` and `dropObjectStorage` (the write-through-spelling pin counts `if (type !== 'object') return;` in `protocol.ts`), `anotherPackageShips` (the register-item pin regex-matches its body; measured red on the trial tree) |
| Moves the read-seam census (8) | `findEnvironmentRows` (89 → 73), `findEnvironmentRow` (→ 82), `findServedOverlayRow` (→ 86), `storedFlowBindingAgrees` (→ 88), `foldStoredCollection` (→ 88), `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` (exit 1, a 70-line `--list` diff: it is the benign-error discriminator), `unmanagedImportCollisions` (→ 88), `rollBackUnmanagedImport` (→ 88) |
| Other (3) | `probeRecord` (the query-options-erasure ratchet reds: a new erasure site in a new file; it is also an engine-double seam), `packagelessAddress` (census 90 → 86), `metaTypeNamespaceExists` (census 90 → 89) |

The census readings in the first rows were taken against base `c5d4634174` (89); the last two against `main` (90).

**The private series is spent.** After this cut no private member with a live body passes the screen. The 57 public members were not screened; inferred-return publics stay, per the seat's shape call.

## Tests

One test file changes, and it is the path-reader migration the ruling requires: `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts` keeps a per-file floor of `new Error(` producers (`PRODUCERS`). Five `new Error(` sites move, so four new modules get their row, under a `[#25467 cut 33]` comment, after `'protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts': 1,`:

```
'protocol-package-scope.ts': 2,
'protocol-unmintable-meta-type.ts': 1,
'protocol-loud-degradations.ts': 1,
'protocol-overlay-index.ts': 1,
```

Each row adds one generated case, so the suite grows by 4 (see Verification). No other test changes. The moved members are driven end to end by the existing suites (package install and uninstall, the `/meta` save and publish doors, view-container expansion, overlay hydration, SDUI page loads); all pass at both ends.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two top-level helpers gain `export` in place.** `rowMatchesOverlayWhere` (read by `overlayLockLayerAt`) and `metadataStoreUnavailableError` (read by `throwMetadataServiceUnavailable`) are `protocol.ts`'s own non-exported functions. Each gains the `export` keyword with nothing else in its statement changed, as `CommitPlanItem` did in cut 32. Both keep readers in `protocol.ts` and stay there. `index.ts` names its re-exports one by one and names neither, so the published surface does not move (the `.d.ts` is raw-identical, below).
- **Imports that lost their last reader are removed from `protocol.ts`**: `isUsableSduiManifest`, `findPageRequiresAbsentFromManifest`, `isWritablePackageShared` (with its `[#7560]` comment), `ensureMetadataOverlayIndexes`, `driverCanRunSql` and `resolveDriverExec` (the whole `driver-exec` import), and `isAppPackageIdKey` (with its `[#23183]` comment). The two comments travel with the import into `protocol-package-scope.ts`. `SDUI_MANIFEST_SERVICE` and `backfillOverlayBundleMembers` stay: docblocks still `@link` them.
- **One read-seam `--list` line changes file, with the same verdict and count.** `recordPackageCommit`'s `catch` that "guards persistPackageCommitRow() → loud (error)" now sits in `protocol-package-commit-record.ts`. The census stays at 90.
- **`check-adr-anchors` counts move, and the gate passes at both ends.** Citations 60,579 → 60,582 and files 8,558 → 8,561, because the moved bodies' ADR citations now also appear in the new modules. Decision-letter citations on the anchored surface go 1,910 → 1,909: one moved letter citation left `protocol.ts` for a module outside the anchored set. `check-adr-symbol-anchors` output is identical.
- **The cut 25 docblock-offset trap did not fire.** The `.d.ts` is raw-identical to `main`.
- **History.** The branch holds the move commit `a04a2c73cc` on `c5d4634174`, one merge of `main` `f7188b562b` (19 commits, none in `packages/metadata-protocol/`), and `044b4d97de`. That commit adds `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, which had been held back and passed every check on a re-measure against `main`, and it adds the `PRODUCERS` rows. The whole move was regenerated by script on that commit, so the two late members follow the same recipe. The first commit's subject says 21 members and seven modules; it moved 20.
- **Branch name.** `claude/project-thread-06v1io` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record.
- **Serial with in-flight PRs.** At `pr_create`, of the 25 open PRs one edits `protocol.ts`: #27535 (permission-set name uniqueness, +57/−3 in `protocol.ts`). `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with its head `4cd524bf0b` is clean, and its added lines call none of the moved members. #26517 (Version Packages) touches only `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json` in this package. `main` moved after the merge (to `aef631b80b`); the one new commit in this package only adds `protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`, and `git merge-tree` with it is clean, so `main` was not merged again.
- **Liveness ledger follow-up, carried forward** (`packages/spec/**`, outside this card): `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19) and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). No row points at this cut's members.
- No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

### The published `.d.ts` (ruling `6348891160`)

Built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree (a full `turbo run build`). The base and `main` legs swapped the package `src/` tree-only and restored it from `HEAD` under a trap; afterwards `git status --porcelain` was empty.

| Reading | Base `c5d4634174` | Move commit `a04a2c73cc` | `main` `f7188b562b` | Final head `044b4d97de` |

| raw sha256 `dist/index.d.ts` = `dist/index.d.cts` | `4cb92b2e20135dd78d07fd2800b1d2a050a432b923cd511d5b50f3ed6de29a58` (784,960 bytes) | same as base | `08235c712877a28a3cdf7c36d96d18fc72b246c8533eae22feb64aaae7af12ea` (785,044 bytes) | same as `main` |

| raw-diff lines | | 0 against base | | 0 against `main` |

The merged tree `2c6ff0ae` gives the `main` hashes too; the `.d.ts` moved between base and `main` only through the merged `main` commits. Bundles change as expected: `index.js` `e5abe0490663649f` → `d80799c603dc52be`, `index.cjs` `1c36338d33aa16a5` → `c8cbc5fc5a540a2d` (sha256, 16). The ESM and CJS export tables are the same 78 names (`e47ac7c753bcb8be`) at both ends; none of the moved functions or the two exported helpers appears.

```
node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum
```

**Positive control.** On the final head `.d.ts`, `private storedRowKnownDatasources;` was made public (a 2-line raw diff). Raw goes to `66b4b1c26cdbfa9b…`, normalised to `b248e476c8ff57fb…`, both different from the bar. So the bar can see a change on a moved member.
